editorial:
You know that feeling when something about your life just doesn't add up? That's exactly where Nathan Harper is at the start of this movie. He's a regular teenager who stumbles onto a missing-persons website and spots a photo that looks exactly like him as a kid. From there, everything unravels fast. His parents aren't who they say they are, and suddenly assassins are chasing him across the country. The only person he can count on is Karen, the girl next door who gets pulled into the chaos. It's a classic on-the-run thriller with a teen hero, big stunts, and a mystery that keeps you guessing.

The action comes fast and loud, with plenty of chases and fight scenes that keep the energy high. Taylor Lautner does his best with the lead role, and the supporting cast adds some weight. The story can feel a little silly at times, and the plot twists aren't always believable, but if you just want a fun, popcorn-style ride, it delivers. Fans of fast-paced action will have a good time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Nathan learns his parents were actually CIA agents assigned to protect him, and his real father was a rogue operative. After a deadly showdown, the assassin hunting him is defeated, but his protectors lose their lives. Nathan and Karen survive and walk away free, though a CIA agent warns they'll be keeping watch. The movie ends with the two of them together, ready to start a new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action thrillers and teen heroes on the run.
